title: Personal loot UUID-group recovery without reward rerolls — 2026-10-18
assumptions: Scope: restore access to double chests whose two valid original ploot UUIDs conflict. Preserve all original player:::UUID loot records; persist shared membership and claims. Existing paid/claimed rewards are never generated again.

Healthy chests retain max-players=5, 3–5 uniform common rolls (expected 4), one independent 10% special roll and up to four one-time debris items. Both live nodes have identical personalloot config. Common pool has 64 entries, total/selectable weight 100; special has five entries, total/selectable weight 100. These are loaded runtime observations, not issuance frequency measurements.

Low/base/high are explicitly illustrative cohorts: 1/3/5 participants each encounters 0.25/1/4 distinct broken eligible groups per active day. Before repair these groups cannot open. Every modeled after event is a new eligible viewer of a distinct group with capacity; repeated openings, repair retries and split/rejoin generate zero additional entitlement.

Existing unclaimed inventory is a restored entitlement, not a new mint. If the player had valid leftovers under both old IDs they remain independently withdrawable; an exhausted, expired or missing record with a surviving claim must not reroll. Claim union can already exceed five from historical separate chests: existing viewers retain access, new viewers are blocked at the unchanged cap.

common_selections and special_selections count weighted selections, not individual items or currency. Item quantities and special item construction remain unchanged. Debris model assumes four free slots; no reward price, multiplier or amount is changed.

Direct Vault, premium tokens, Elite Coins and XP issuance from this recovery is zero. Material resale, AE-item sale and potion-token redemption are downstream alternative flows, not included as cash income without measured item-specific prices and use. Current SELL availability is not assumed off; planned SELL-to-contract transition remains future. Selling and contracting the same item are mutually exclusive.

No price/progression cost changes; saving time is not applicable. Main abuse boundary is reconnect/retry/restart/split/rejoin, not a time cooldown. Group aliases and claim history must survive these operations. Malformed identities and storage errors fail closed.

Live shared ledger sample 2026-10-18: since=1791742650973 generatedAt=1792347450975, 12869 records, 66306 operations, 31 players; classified record ratio=0.989198849949491, 139 unknown/legacy records. It has no reliable counter for affected chest encounters and is not used to invent their frequency or a monetary loot EV.

decision: Restore intended once-per-player access while preserving original rewards, historical claims and the existing player cap. Rates are unchanged; actual recovered item access increases from the broken state. Do not infer zero realized item impact from unchanged configured rates.
